baris.sari: Since November 4, 116 reactive contracts on Lasna went dark. 97 are still dark.
baris.baca: Since November fourth, one hundred and sixteen reactive contracts on Lasna went dark. Ninety-seven are still dark.

baris.sari: They ran out of gas money, and they got no warning.
I'm not a developer. I can't watch a dashboard. So I built Pelita. I fill one tank. It does the rest.
Here a contract runs dry. Reactive's own system contract announces it. Pelita hears that event and refuels it in the same reaction.
On Base Sepolia the refill arrives as a callback. Its twin without Pelita received 4 of 462 heartbeats.
baris.baca: On Base Sepolia the refill arrives as a callback. Its twin without Pelita received four of four hundred and sixty-two heartbeats.

baris.sari: 52 outages on Lasna, 17 on Base Sepolia. Every one was relit. Median: 1 second. Every hash is in the repo.

baris.sari: The page checks any contract's fuel, and shows who is dark right now. Anyone can relight them.
No polling bot. It costs nothing until something goes dark.
